title: Feedback:Game updates/20260617
wikitext:
== Update, June 17, 2026 ==

=== Mobile ===
* Autorun and target viewing buttons are now available on the mobile HUD
* Support has been added for gamepads on mobile devices; we're still refining this but it works very similar to Steam Deck controls
* Fixed a bug for an occasional crash on Android when selecting a character
* Fixed a bug for an occasional crash on iOS when switching back to the app
* Mobile privacy and tracking options are now displayed on app start for everyone
* You can now rotate your character on the character select screen with touch controls
* Vendor panels have revised mobile layouts to make them easier to use
* Dye and trade panels are no longer full screen on mobile (custom mobile dye and trade UIs are coming in a future update)
* We continue to work on "Login with Steam" as a mobile feature
** It's tricky and uses special access APIs issued by Valve (which they have done and which we are integrating with our systems)
** It requires updating our "login server" infrastructure
** We think we're pretty close but it will definitely not be available June 24

=== Steam Deck and Gamepads ===
* Pressing the right analog stick ("R3") centers the camera on Steam Deck and mobile gamepads
